title: Add TypeScript contract-first RAG workshop and lightweight tool-schema linter
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: The team wants a reproducible, hands-on TypeScript workshop that teaches a contract-first approach to building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) agents and safe tool-calling. This PR adds a guided workshop with step exercises, a tiny tool-schema linter (node script) to validate tool contract shapes, and docs updates: 1) a dev workshop under examples/ts-workshops/rag-contract-first, 2) an interactive README with exercises and expected outputs, 3) sample agent and tool implementations that show structured responses and explicit tool contracts, and 4) a short guide for shipping contract tests into CI. Checklist: - [x] Add workshop skeleton and seed data - [x] Implement lightweight linter (schema-check) + unit tests - [x] Add sample agent + example tool adapters (HTTP, local stub) - [x] Add docs/README with exercise solutions gated behind a flag - [x] Wire up CI smoke test (workshop smoke) - [x] Add telemetry probes in examples to show events for authoring UX Note: this is focused on examples and docs only; it does not change runtime or SDK surface. Linear: ENG-8421 tracks the linter work and workshop authoring. Testing: CI includes a smoke job that runs the workshop runner (node) in headless mode to validate the examples and the linter. Migration/risk: Non-breaking; safe to merge to main. Rollout: merged to main, will be referenced in next docs release notes and showcased in the monthly workshop webinar.
